description: She wears a long rust-red textured gown with a low square neckline bordered by narrow gold geometric trim. The fitted bodice has elbow-length sleeves with small fastenings at the outer arms. An ochre woven shawl wraps around both forearms, with red and gold borders and short fringe. A slim decorated brown leather belt with a circular buckle secures the waist. The floor-length skirt opens down the front to show an ivory underdress and brown leather shoes. The fabric is opaque. She wears no headgear or armor.
